display.label: IAM & Security
display.description: Manage Service Accounts, Custom Roles, and Project/Resource level IAM role bindings.

globals.label: Project ID
globals.description: GCP Project ID in which IAM resources will be managed.

resource.key_description: Unique key identifier for this IAM configuration entry.

sections.label: Principal Selection
sections.description: Specify the principal (New Service Account, Existing Service Account, or User/Group Email) for this IAM configuration.

validation.pattern_error: Must start with a lowercase letter, contain lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.

fields.label: New Service Account ID
fields.description: Account ID for a NEW service account to create. Leave blank if using an existing SA or user email.

fields.label: Existing Service Account Email
fields.description: Select an existing Service Account. Do not set if creating a new Service Account.

fields.label: User / Group Principal Email
fields.description: Direct principal email (e.g., user:john@example.com or group:devs@example.com). Only set when NOT using a Service Account.

sections.label: Project-Level Roles
sections.description: Project-level IAM roles assigned to the principal.

fields.label: Project Roles
fields.description: IAM roles (e.g., roles/viewer, roles/storage.objectAdmin) granted to the principal at the project level.

sections.label: Custom Role Creation
sections.description: Optionally define a new custom IAM role for the project.

fields.label: Custom Role ID
fields.description: Unique ID for the custom role (e.g. appDeployer). Leave blank if not creating a custom role.

fields.label: Custom Role Permissions
fields.description: GCP permissions assigned to this custom role (e.g. storage.buckets.get, compute.instances.list).

sections.label: Service Account IAM Policy
sections.description: Grant other members roles directly ON the created or referenced Service Account.
